opening: This second act adds a subnet to network. Its id is known only after apply.

pull-request.prompt: Add a second subnet to network; put a worker in it.
pull-request.reply: Opened pull request {pull}. network adds subnet b and app adds a worker in it. edge allows the new range. Plan all three stacks next.

tips.title: One plan, three stacks
tips.body: chant plans all three stacks in one pass and posts one note with one digest. A stack that reads another's output is planned on what that output will be.

planned.reply: One plan across 3 stacks. Only one value is unknown: subnet b's id, which app's worker needs.

planned.prompt: What depends on the new subnet?
planned.reply: One resource reads it: app's worker. Edge allows the subnet's range, but it never reads the id.

tips.title: Known after apply
tips.body: CloudFormation gives a new subnet its id only when it creates it. chant previews app's change set with a stand-in for that id and marks the worker's SubnetId as known after apply. Before it runs the real change set, it checks it against the preview.

approved.status: Recording your approval of the plan's digest

tips.title: One approval
tips.body: Once network applies, chant plans app again with the real id. The approval already given covers that plan if it only fills in what the preview marked unknown.

merged.status: Merging; the apply job runs the stacks in order

tips.title: Parameters, not exports
tips.body: Each stack reads the one before it through parameters that chant fills from its outputs with stackOutput. No CloudFormation exports are involved.

applying.status: Applying the three stacks in order

tips.title: One approval
tips.body: Once network applies, chant plans app again with the real id. The approval already given covers that plan if it only fills in what the preview marked unknown.

tips.title: A stock chant project
tips.body: These are three stacks in a chant project. The pull request pipeline is the one chant generates for the project. No other tool is in it.

applied.reply: Done. Subnet b was created and app's worker got its id in the same apply.
No. CloudFormation locks a stack while its update runs and lets go when it ends. All three updates finished, so no stack is locked.

tips.title: Locking
tips.body: CloudFormation locks a stack while one of its updates runs. chant runs one change set per stack, and each stack here waits for the one before it to finish.
